label: VVX 450 IP phone
description: Polycom VVX 450 12-line business media desk phone with a 4.3-inch colour display and a two-port 10/100/1000 switch wired as LAN plus PC passthrough. PoE 802.3af class 0 at up to 13 W, or the optional 5 V DC adapter.
notes: Datasheet: 'Two-port Gigabit Ethernet switch 10/100/1000Base-TX across LAN and PC ports', 'built-in auto sensing IEEE 802.3af Power over Ethernet (Class 0) 13 W (maximum)'. Class 0 is the full 13.0 W PD budget - a fat load for an access port and a good test case for a switch that only does 802.3af class 2/3. Up to 34 SIP registrations, LDAP, SRTP/TLS. Wi-Fi only via an optional USB adapter, so no wireless interface is modelled; the two USB 2.0 Type-A ports are not modelled.
